\label{thm:main}
If $\deg F\le5$, the system \eqref{eq:original-system} has at most
two limit cycles in $\R^2$. Some members of this class have two
limit cycles. Thus its exact maximum is two.

statements.name: Uniform boundedness
statements.text:
\label{thm:uniform}
For each integer \(d\geq1\), there is a finite nonnegative integer \(B(d)\)
such that every real planar polynomial vector field of degree at most \(d\)
has at most \(B(d)\) limit cycles in the whole plane.
